mechanism_arms.name: no_calibration
mechanism_arms.definition: No activity signature and no carrier; compatible fixed missing/zero representation.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: Architecture compatibility and identical live-unit masks.

mechanism_arms.name: activity_only_B3S
mechanism_arms.definition: Activity-derived identity only; remove carrier from both embedding and direct path.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: No target labels influence the identity.

mechanism_arms.name: carrier_only
mechanism_arms.definition: Carrier retained, activity identity fixed/zero; live neural stream remains present.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: Only static activity identity is removed.

mechanism_arms.name: joint_T4
mechanism_arms.definition: Activity identity plus functional carrier condition the same decoder.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: Budget and all non-information factors match B/C.

mechanism_arms.name: unit_shuffled_carrier
mechanism_arms.definition: One unit permutation applied before embedding and direct carrier fusion.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: Permutation hash and independent-training semantics recorded.

mechanism_arms.name: mean_vs_slot
mechanism_arms.definition: Mean pooling versus learned slot aggregation with matched downstream dimensions.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: Same input, horizon, selection, and query.

mechanism_arms.name: nonattention_vs_temporal
mechanism_arms.definition: Matched causal non-attention temporal control versus transformer.
mechanism_arms.acceptance: Same frontend, receptive field, and reporting of parameter/compute differences.

deletion_rules: Without four qualified effects, delete four-dataset matched-evaluation and conclusion claims.
Without M1 paired outcome, remove M1 as empirical dataset.
Without B binding, remove B architecture and B-minus-profile claims.
Without independently trained controls, remove causal mechanism attribution.
Without Kalman/PV real-data receipts, use N/A or remove rows.
Without RIFT cached-CPU parity and a benchmark for a reported task, remove its RIFT runtime number; rewrite legacy E-ORT/ONNX text regardless of further BT-EORT measurement.
